name: sky.money USDS Flagship
oneLiner: skyMoneyUsdsFlagship is a Sky.money-curated Morpho lending vault over USDS; interest and losses change its share value, and exits depend on liquidity.
collateral: USDS held idle or supplied through Sky.money-curated Morpho lending markets
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 shares represent a pro-rata USDS-denominated claim on idle tokens and Morpho lender positions. Interest accrual and realized losses change the exchange rate; redeem/withdraw delivers USDS when vault and market liquidity allow.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: The exact Ethereum deployment 0xe15fcc81118895b67b6647bbd393182df44e11e0 is an immutable Morpho Vault V2 lender share over USDS. The holder has an operational pro-rata vault claim, not direct title to borrower collateral or a fiat claim. Its local conservation, allocation and recovery mechanics differ from the tracked parent. Exact implementation creation is pinned by transaction 0xbecea2aa97133574b2e3251bc794e0d827b473d2ac78311ba788e22d2c651b3e, block 24441155, timestamp 2026-02-12T14:00:11+00:00, independently joined from Blockscout to RPC receipt and block timestamp on2026-10-03. This is the implementation launch, not issuer founding or parent-token launch.
